# Obligation

## Summary
A promise a contract compels, with a date and an owner: `contract`, `obligationType` (payment, delivery, notification, compliance, insurance, audit), `description`, `consequence` (what a miss costs), `amount`, `recurrence` (the catalog Recurring Pattern field), `firstDueDate`, `completions`, `owner`, `escalatedTo` and reminder settings.

## Why not a Task
A task is work somebody chose to do; an obligation is work a signed agreement requires. Missing one is a breach, not a slipped plan, so lateness carries a consequence sentence and an escalation, which the catalog Task has no place for.

## What is derived
`status` and `nextDueDate` are computed from the recurrence and the completions, never stored — a stored status is the most drift-prone value in a compliance view, where a dashboard buckets by date while a pill reads the stored enum.

## Usage
```ts
import { Obligation } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/legal/obligation';

@field obligations = linksToMany(() => Obligation);
```

A Contract lists its obligations by querying Obligation on `contract`.

## Non-goals
No reminder sending; the reminder fields record who should be told and when. No automatic completion.
